description:
Connect file-based extension discovery (existing OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Loader) to the runtime Runner so .octo_pi/extensions/ extensions actually load when a session starts. PR #5's runner only supports programmatic registration; this ticket adds the disk-discovery bridge.

## Deliverable

Session.init/1 returns {:ok, state, {:continue, :load_extensions}}. handle_continue starts the Runner, runs Loader on standard_dirs, registers each loaded extension with the runner. Heavy work happens after init returns so the supervisor isn't blocked.

## Steps

STEP 1 — Update Session.init/1 to call Process.flag(:trap_exit, true) and return {:ok, state, {:continue, :load_extensions}}.

STEP 2 — Implement Session.handle_continue(:load_extensions, state):
  - :telemetry.execute([:octo_pi_coder, :extensions, :load_started], %{}, %{session_pid: self()})
  - {:ok, runner} = OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Runner.start_link(session_pid: self())
  - results = state.cwd |> Loader.standard_dirs() |> Loader.discover_all() |> Loader.load_all()
  - Enum.each(results, &Runner.register(runner, &1))
  - :telemetry.execute([:octo_pi_coder, :extensions, :load_complete], %{count: length(results)}, %{session_pid: self(), extension_ids: Enum.map(results, & &1.id)})
  - {:noreply, %{state | runner: runner}}

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Session.init/1 source contains `{:continue, :load_extensions}` (verifiable via grep)
- [ ] Session.handle_continue(:load_extensions, _) function defined
- [ ] Process.flag(:trap_exit, true) called in Session.init
- [ ] Telemetry events :load_started and :load_complete are emitted (verify via attached test handler)
- [ ] Test: place a fixture extension in a tmp dir, start Session with cwd=tmp, attach to :load_complete telemetry, assert_receive within 1s with the expected extension_ids in metadata. NO Process.sleep.
- [ ] When `mix pi` runs with .octo_pi/extensions/ping.ex present, telemetry fires :loaded for "ping" (verifiable via --debug-telemetry log)
- [ ] Session is responsive (handle_call replies) after init returns even if extension load is mid-flight

## Dependencies
